scope: Source-coordinate registration assessment only. Neither source model nor mounted geometry is changed. Does not qualify VIMS pointing or native detector coverage.

method.qualityMask: 2023 source numimg>=5, numimg<9999, 0<bestmap<=1500m; abs(lat)<60; interior ICQ records only
method.partition: 30-degree longitude by 20-degree latitude patches; 2-degree guard strips; (lonBin+2*latBin)%3; train=0, disjoint holdouts=1,2
method.sampling: At most 200 deterministic original vertex records per patch; at most1200 nearest-triangle queries per partition
method.fit: Robust translation from training candidate record displacements; independent KD-tree nearest-vertex, local-neighborhood and exact-triangle distance checks afterward
method.surfaceDistance: Closest points on original 2023 source triangles; KD-tree centroid candidates; certify nearest using global triangle bounding radius, enlarge neighborhood from64 to512 when needed
method.limits: Same-record candidates are not assumed identical physical points. Shape changes remain residuals. Geographic heldouts measure registration transferability, not source-author exact displacement or spacecraft pointing.

surfaceRefinement.method: Training-only robust point-to-plane translation with updated certified nearest original triangles, at most12 iterations. No rotation or scale fitted. Geographic holdouts unchanged.
